rules.implementation: Native actual DiscardPhaseStarting; optional one physical owned HE entity enters an exact public pile. A separate optional attack chooses three exact Xingwu pile entities or true native turnover plus two actual hand cards. The full target equipment removal, native Lion recovery and Ox grain children finish before native male two / female one damage. No color restriction, male-only target restriction or damage-before-equipment ordering from the historical version.

links.currentRule: Prevent the genuine incoming damage by the native heart payment, then choose incoming-source one damage plus lost-HP draw capped at five, or one HP loss plus obtain the exact discarded entity.
The existing native redirect, real HE cost, actual attack range and exclusion of the actual Slash source.

rules.implementation: Two independently source-aware derived grants follow public pile nonzero presence and the exact active Luoyan capability grant/instance. Empty pile, suppression, source loss or death revoke only that relation. Independent acquired copies of Tianxiang and Liuli survive. No Hongyan grant. Isolated registries also register boundary:xiao-qiao and classic:da-qiao to load the actual linked definitions.

historicalBoundary: Canonical cha_spell.o and current hero permit one card on the pile, then either remove three Xingwu cards OR turn over and discard two hand cards; strip all target equipment before male 2 / female 1 damage. Preserve both payment branches and female target.

The historical 2016 official-hosted guide has the OLD hand-color restriction / automatic three-card male-only attack / damage-before-strip sequence. It proves formal OL availability, not the present skill behavior.

Current linked spell 382 is the two-option Tianxiang with one incoming-source damage capped lost-HP draw or lose-HP plus obtain discarded heart. Reuse boundary:tianxiang, not old classic Tianxiang; Luoyan does not grant Hongyan.
Ten-anniversary / yijiangchengming x.sanguosha.com/hero/517.html is a different product and has different Xingwu suit-count damage; excluded.
implementationInferences: Current wording one card is interpreted as an owned hand or equipment entity; Wooden Ox stored grain is not itself ordinary owned HE and is not silently treated as a hand card for this deposit.
The second you may is independent of placing a card: declining or lacking the first optional deposit still permits a payable second branch; current text contains no if you do gate.
The three-pile-card branch accepts any three real Xingwu entities owned by the character, including retained pile source instances; it never replaces a physical pile with a synthetic count.

For the alternate cost, native turnover children resolve before selecting the current two discardable hand entities. If fewer than two remain after a real child, the already completed turnover is retained and the unpaid attack ends; no missing payment or damage is invented.
Current effective target sex is read after the target equipment-removal children complete, rather than copying sex from an earlier private menu.

Native unmovable or protected equipment and GeneralWeapon OutsideGame replacement retain the existing native card-movement rules. The effect attempts all currently discardable target equipment, then continues its native damage.

Loss of source after a paid current binding does not repay it. Death before a new private attack choice terminates that unissued optional attack; a fully paid attack with frozen target retains its mandatory native equipment-removal and damage continuation even if the original source dies.

The old official 2016 guide establishes formal OL availability only. Its color-restricted hand deposit, male-only automatic burst and damage-before-equipment text are not current rules; the current hero/client override them.
These composed timing and zone details are implementation inferences from current wording and native resolution contracts; no dedicated official FAQ is claimed for them.

runtimeBoundary.ownership: Luoyan uses genuine native SkillGrant source relations, revision changes and real SkillsChanged windows. The old revision baseline is primed only when absent. Pure source/pile qualification rejects stale derived grants and a native-style dependency stamp invalidates cached bindings before synchronization.

verification.scope: Real public-pile entities and zero/nonzero derived sources; independent skills retained; both costs and actual male/female damage; real Lion/Ox removal, logical discard and recovery/death children; both current Tianxiang branches and native Liuli; private prompt isolation and deterministic cold replay.
